description: Screenshot of an anonymous 4chan/8chan post (04/11/18) showing two attached images side by side: a Wired-style article headlined 'Pentagon Kills LifeLog Project' about DARPA canceling its LifeLog database program, and a Wikipedia infobox for Facebook showing its founding date of February 4, 2004. The poster's caption claims the Pentagon killed LifeLog the same day Facebook was formed. Below is a Q reply (ID a3385e, No.1003596) responding '>>1003248 Finder of this should apply to NSA. Q'.
text: Anonymous 04/11/18 (Wed) 19:43:06 ID: cf14d3 No.1003248. File: Capture_2.jpg (81.89 KB, 593x522). File: Capture_3.jpg (28.42 KB, 270x354). PENTAGON KILLS LIFELOG PROJECT. THE PENTAGON CANCELED its so-called LifeLog project, an ambitious effort to build a database tracking a person's entire existence. Run by Darpa, the Defense Department's research arm, LifeLog aimed to gather in a single place just about everything an individual says, sees or does: the phone calls made, the TV shows watched, the magazines read, the plane tickets bought, the e-mail sent and received. Out of this seemingly endless ocean of information, computer scientists would plot distinctive routes in the data, mapping relationships, memories, events and experiences. facebook. description: Photograph of a person in a camouflage jacket and khaki trousers standing beneath a Persian street sign, holding a handwritten paper sign over their face. The street sign reads 'Khiaban-e Naqsh-e Jahan' in Persian with partial English 'NAGH... AVE.', consistent with Naqsh-e Jahan Avenue in Iran (Naqsh-e Jahan Square is in Isfahan). The handheld sign reads '#Restart MIGA', 'MIGA + MAGA', '#QANON' with a drawn heart, apparently signaling support from Iran's 'Restart' movement for QAnon and 'Make Iran Great Again'.
